user.title: Add a car
user.description: Pick the car from the Mercedes integration (mbapi2020) to fill in its sensors automatically, or leave it empty to choose them yourself.

entities.title: Car sensors and settings
entities.description: Check the sensors. Battery capacity is the usable size in kWh (for example 66.5 for an EQA 250).{model_note} Everything else is optional. Charging costs use the rates you set for each place in the card's Charging tab (Home included, with an optional off-peak window); a live price sensor, if you pick one, is used for home charges instead. A home charger meter gives the most accurate home energy.

data.ignition_entity: Ignition state (optional; without it trips are detected from the car moving)
data.charge_power_entity: Charging power (also costs home charges when there is no charger meter)
data.charger_energy_entity: Home charger energy meter, total kWh (optional)
data.price_entity: Live electricity price sensor (optional; without it, home charges use the rates you set in the Charging tab)
data.stop_minutes: Minutes parked before a trip ends
data.outside_temp_entity: Outside temperature for efficiency vs temperature (optional; leave empty to use Home Assistant's local weather)
data.summary_notify: Monthly summary (optional; sent on the 1st at 09:00)

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Rebuilds trips and charges from Home Assistant's recorded history for the time before the car was added. Re-running replaces earlier imports; live-logged trips are never touched.

days.name: Days
days.description: How far back to look (limited by how long the recorder keeps history).

fill_gaps.name: Fill in missed trips
fill_gaps.description: Finds driving that wasn't logged, such as while Home Assistant was offline: wherever the odometer moved between two logged trips, it adds a missed trip with that distance, from where the car was parked to where it was next seen. There's no route, and several drives in one gap become one trip. Safe to run again.

send_summary.name: Send monthly summary
send_summary.description: Sends last month's summary now, to each car that has a monthly summary set in its options.
